metabolic.lipidSynthesis.label: cholesterol and lipid synthesis
metabolic.lipidSynthesis.reason: This model has no cholesterol or lipid pool, so lowering its synthesis changes nothing it shows.

metabolic.urateProduction.label: uric acid production
metabolic.urateProduction.reason: This model has no uric acid pool, so lowering its production changes nothing it shows.

metabolic.basalRate.label: basal metabolic rate
metabolic.basalRate.reason: Nothing in this model reads a thyroid-driven change in resting metabolic rate, so this effect is not shown.

metabolic.ketogenesis.label: ketone production
metabolic.ketogenesis.reason: This model has no ketone-body pool, so a change in ketone production changes nothing it shows.

metabolic.proteinCatabolism.label: protein breakdown
metabolic.proteinCatabolism.reason: This model has no muscle protein store, so a change in protein breakdown changes nothing it shows.

metabolic.lipolysis.label: fat breakdown
metabolic.lipolysis.reason: This model has no fat store, and nothing in it writes or reads fat breakdown.

renal.reninRelease.label: renin release
renal.reninRelease.reason: This model has no renin and angiotensin system, so a change in renin release changes nothing it shows.

renal.erythropoiesis.label: red blood cell production by the kidney signal
renal.erythropoiesis.reason: Nothing in this model reads the kidney's erythropoietin drive, so red cell mass does not respond to it.

blood.erythropoiesis.label: red blood cell production
blood.erythropoiesis.reason: This model does not change red cell production over time, so nothing writes or reads this effect.

bone.resorption.label: bone breakdown
bone.resorption.reason: This model has no bone remodelling, so nothing writes or reads this effect.

immune.histamineRelease.label: histamine release
immune.histamineRelease.reason: Histamine is carried here by its own effects on blood vessels and airways, so this separate release label is only a record and changes nothing.

vascular.tone.label: general vascular tone
vascular.tone.reason: Blood vessel tone is carried here by systemic resistance, so this separate label is only a record; the drug's effect on resistance is still modelled.
